reasoning.summary: The Knights hold a significant advantage in the standings (7th vs 12th) and points differential (+60 vs -59), supported by superior recent form including a dominant win over Brisbane. While math drivers such as Bradley-Terry strength and Elo ratings suggest a latent ability edge for the Raiders, the overall attribution balance leans toward Newcastle despite the loss of Bradman Best to injury.

Newcastle enters following an emphatic 30-6 win over Brisbane, whereas Canberra was comprehensively beaten 42-18 by Penrith (BeforeYouBet); however, Newcastle will miss Bradman Best due to a calf strain (nrl.com).
